en.headline: Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances exhibition continues at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the free exhibition under the theme Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting runs until 29 November in Tsim Sha Tsui.
body: An exhibition accompanying the Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ 2026 continues at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui until 29 November.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the outdoor carnival, themed Blessings in Full Bloom, took place on 22 November. The accompanying exhibition, under the theme Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting, highlights multicultural heritage through displays from around 30 Belt and Road countries and regions. Admission is free.
The exhibition is open from 9am to 11pm on 23 to 28 November and from 9am to 5pm on 29 November, at the foyer and piazza of the Cultural Centre on Salisbury Road.

zh.headline: 亞裔民族文化表演展於文化中心持續舉行至11月29日
zh.dek: 康文署表示，免費展覽以「跨文化饋贈的匯聚」為主題，於尖沙咀香港文化中心舉行。
body: 「亞裔民族文化表演+ 2026」配套展覽於尖沙咀香港文化中心持續舉行，至11月29日結束。
康樂及文化事務署表示，以「百花齊放」為主題的戶外嘉年華於11月22日舉行。配套展覽以「跨文化饋贈的匯聚」為題，透過來自約30個一帶一路國家及地區的展品展示多元文化。入場免費。
展覽於11月23至28日上午9時至晚上11時開放，29日則由上午9時至下午5時，地點為梳士巴利道文化中心大堂及廣場。
